definitions.explanation: the legal process of seizing property or assets by court order, typically to satisfy a debt or judgment

examples.japanese: {財産|ざいさん}を{差|さ}し{押|お}さえる。
{給料|きゅうりょう}の{差|さ}し{押|お}さえを{受|う}けた。
{裁判所|さいばんしょ}から{差|さ}し{押|お}さえ{命令|めいれい}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: A seizure order was issued by the court.

notes:
{差|さ}し{押|お}さえ is a legal term for court-ordered seizure of assets.

VERB FORMATION:
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえる (to seize - ichidan verb)

COMMON TARGETS OF SEIZURE:
- {財産|ざいさん} (property)
- {預金|よきん} (bank deposits)
- {給料|きゅうりょう}/{給与|きゅうよ} (salary)
- {不動産|ふどうさん} (real estate)
- {動産|どうさん} (movable property)

LEGAL COLLOCATIONS:
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえ{命令|めいれい} (seizure order)
- {仮|かり}{差|さ}し{押|お}さえ (provisional seizure)
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえ{解除|かいじょ} (release of seizure)
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえ{禁止|きんし} (prohibition of seizure)

USAGE:
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえを{受|う}ける (to have assets seized)
- {差|さ}し{押|お}さえられる (to be seized)

NOTE:
Used in contexts of debt collection, legal judgments, and tax enforcement.
